# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Parent = cand_0001 (val 0.634). Capability = spreadsheet agent system prompt (`prompt.md`). Reader = azure/gpt-5.5 (strong). Only `prompt.md` editable.

## Method
Fanned out 5 read-only general-purpose subagents (one per trajectory group) over ALL 25 failing + 15 flaky traces in `./trajectories/`, each reporting per-task root cause + whether a GENERAL prompt rule fixes it without hardcoding. Then verified the top candidates directly against the trace `rollout.output` code. Every failure here is "produced output, wrong values" — NOT an environment fault (code runs, files save). iter1 already covered the formula-as-value / VBA-as-value / hardcode-constant clusters, so those are excluded.

## Ranked cluster list (this iteration's NEW, generalizable clusters)
| rank | cluster | tasks | root cause | tag |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | READ scope confused with WRITE scope (answer_position) | 250-20, 49782, 53305, 55039, 50526 | code bounds/locates the data it READS by the answer range (e.g. `max_row=20`, count capped at range end, read-column = fixed offset from answer cells) → drops rows / mislocates columns when hidden files differ | STRUCTURE/KNOWLEDGE |
| 2 | Value/type fidelity vs the grader | 35747, 58890, 53062, 50486, 250-20 | text-stored numbers/dates silently skipped in numeric compares; exact-equality joins fail across int/float/str/whitespace; numeric answer written as text `"1"` (grader compares TYPE) | CONTRACT/KNOWLEDGE |
| 3 | Unmatched lookup written as blank not `#N/A` | 31420 | VLOOKUP-replica writes `None` for no-match; expected literal `#N/A` → type mismatch = 0 | KNOWLEDGE/CONTRACT |
| — | per-task logic / instruction ambiguity | 34-5 (nondeterministic "current month"), 398-14 (sign), 254-34 (compute-vs-format), 146-49/413-15 (unspecified order), 269-44, 39946, 32468, 18137, 32023, 14207, 42930, 49237, 53957, 56561, 55258, 6698, 48983, 53449, 45944, 32975, 55912, 139-16, 585-41, 50755, 4225 | each a distinct wrong computation; no general prose rule without hardcoding the answer | skipped |
| — | ground-truth casing noise | 4225 (`"Non green"`), 10281 (`"Pass"`) | GT casing contradicts the instruction AND adjacent cells — any casing rule would be wrong and could regress passers | skipped (handed back) |

## Edits made (3 additive; multiple distinct lever types)
1. **Read-scope / locate-by-header** (STRUCTURE + missing-knowledge; new bullet after the Sheet-Level line). "answer_position tells you ONLY WHERE TO WRITE … does NOT bound the data you READ. Read/scan/count/aggregate over the full populated region (`ws.max_row`/actual extent); locate read columns by HEADER TEXT, never by a fixed offset from / the size of the answer range." Lever: missing-rule + ordered-check.
2. **Value-and-TYPE fidelity** (output-contract + knowledge; new bullet). Coerce text→number/date on both sides before any compare/aggregate/match; strip whitespace on string keys; WRITE a numeric/date answer as a number/datetime, not text (grader compares stored type: `"1"` ≠ `1`). Lever: tighten output contract + add WHY (grader mechanic).
3. **Unmatched-lookup → `#N/A`** (missing-knowledge, bounded). When reproducing VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH and a key has no match, write the literal `#N/A` the formula would return, not `None`/blank (unless instruction says leave empty). Lever: add missing rule grounded in grader behavior.
4. **Pre-finish checklist** extended from 3→4 points to make edits 1–3 unavoidable final checks (structural lever, restates the above as work-to-perform for gpt-5.5).

## Verify-the-fix (trace → what changes)
- 250-20 (flaky): code sets `min_row,max_row=1,20` and reads rows only `2..20` because the range ends at row 20 → misses hidden rows past 20. Edit 1 → read to `ws.max_row`. Confirmed in `rollout.output`.
- 49782 (flaky): counts occurrences only in `range(header_row+1, end_row+1)` (≤ row 11 = answer end) → sequence numbers wrong when matches exist below row 11. Edit 1 → count over full extent.
- 53305 / 55039 (0/3): read columns anchored at fixed offsets from the answer cells (`min_col-1`, `min_col-2`, `-11,-7,-4…`) → wrong when hidden layout shifts. Edit 1 → locate by header.
- 35747 (broken by iter1): `to_dt` only parses `datetime`/`fromisoformat`; text-stored numbers/dates skipped → wrong count. Edit 2 → coerce before compare.
- 58890 (0/3): lookup keyed on raw `(ro,bucket)` tuples, exact-equality join fails on int/float/str/whitespace across hidden files. Edit 2 → normalize keys before match.
- 53062 (flaky): writes the string `"1"` into Q cells; grader type-compares → `"1"`≠`1`. Edit 2 → write numeric 1.
- 31420 (broken by iter1): writes `None` for unmatched VLOOKUP; GT is `'#N/A'` → type mismatch. Edit 3 → write `#N/A`.

## Blast-radius per edit (SAFE test; passing class named)
- **Edit 1 (read-scope)** — BOUNDED additive. All 51 passing tasks pass all 3 hidden cases, i.e. already generalize → they either read full extent or their extent coincides with the answer range (reading full extent yields the identical result). It does NOT loosen the WRITE constraint (bullets 6/7 still restrict writes to answer_position). "Locate by header, not offset from answer range" does not affect passers that use headers or instruction-named columns (a named column ≠ an offset from the answer range). No passing trajectory changes.
- **Edit 2 (type fidelity)** — BOUNDED additive; scoped to compare/aggregate/match and to numeric/date OUTPUT. Coercion is a no-op on already-consistent data (passers). Writing numbers as numbers is what passing numeric tasks already do; scoped to "intended answer is a numeric quantity/date" so text codes/labels are untouched.
- **Edit 3 (#N/A)** — BOUNDED additive; fires ONLY on an unmatched lookup key. Passing lookup tasks (2212, 34210, 50452, 44264, 51859, … pass 3/3) always find matches → the miss branch is never taken → behavior unchanged.
- **Checklist** — additive structural restatement; introduces no new behavior.
- Left every existing rule intact (macro/VBA, literal-not-formula, derive-dynamically, save, error-recovery). No deletions.

## Building on prior RESULTS
- Built ON accepted cand_0001. Edits 2 & 3 specifically REPAIR iter1's `broke={31420, 35747}` regressions (its literal-not-formula rule made the agent evaluate lookups/counts in Python and then mishandle unmatched-key `#N/A` and text-typed values) — these are NEW additive rules, not a re-run of iter1's diff.
- Did NOT re-try any regressing edit from iter1 (it added only macro/literal/derive rules; my three rules are orthogonal).
- Refuted/avoided: no casing rule (subagent showed 4225/10281 GT casing contradicts the instruction → chasing it would regress passers).

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- ~24 per-task logic / instruction-ambiguity errors (see table): each a distinct wrong computation; no general prose rule fixes them without hardcoding an answer (overfit → rejected).
- Casing-noise (4225, 10281): ground-truth contradicts the visible instruction; not prose-fixable safely.
- 34-5 "current month" is nondeterministic (gold froze a date the agent cannot know).

## Features used
5 parallel read-only subagents for diagnosis (one per trajectory group); direct code-verification of the 6 highest-leverage traces before committing each edit.
